name: Piloos PDF
description: Read and edit PDF files: reflow text to fit the screen, change the text on the page, fill in forms, highlight, draw and stamp, add pictures, sign, black out private details, find and replace, and rearrange, trim, number and watermark pages. Works on phone, tablet and computer, keeps a draft of your edits and works offline.
